questions.signal: Has operated a model in production and learned from it going wrong
questions.prompt: Tell me about a time a model you shipped behaved worse in production than in evaluation.
idealAnswerPoints: root cause such as drift or train/serve skew
followUpHooks: How did you separate a data problem from a model problem?
What monitoring would have caught it earlier?

criteria.structure: Situation, task, action and result are each clear and in order
criteria.specificity: Concrete details: names, numbers, dates rather than generalities
criteria.impact: States a measurable or observable outcome
criteria.ownership: names the debugging steps and fixes they personally drove

questions.signal: Understands why retrieval-augmented systems fail and how to measure them
questions.prompt: How would you diagnose and improve a RAG chatbot over internal docs that gives confident but wrong answers?
idealAnswerPoints: separates retrieval failures from generation failures
inspects retrieved chunks and measures recall on a labelled set
chunking, hybrid search or reranking changes
grounding and abstain behaviour in the prompt
weakAnswerSigns: changes several things at once without measuring
followUpHooks: How would you build an evaluation set for this?
What would you check if the right chunk is retrieved but the answer is still wrong?
How do you stop the model answering when retrieval comes back empty?

criteria.correctness: Approach produces correct results on the stated problem
criteria.depth: Explains why it works and its time/space cost
criteria.edge_cases: Considers empty retrieval, stale or conflicting chunks, and questions whose answer lies outside the retrieved context
criteria.communication: Explains clearly how they would isolate retrieval failures from generation failures
